page_title: EIN 2-0 DOR | Eintracht Frankfurt v Dortmund 17/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+5' Dortmund failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90+4' Today's match ends for Hugo Ekitike who will be replaced by Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt).
90+2' 2 - 0 Goal! It's a catastrophic error from the opponent which has gifted a chance to Oscar Hojlund (Eintracht Frankfurt), who rolls the ball into the back of the net from close range. 2:0.
90+2' The corner is swung in but Dortmund can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!
87' That will be all from Julian Ryerson who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Giovanni Reyna (Dortmund).
87' The substitution has been made. Can Yilmaz Uzun (Eintracht Frankfurt) has replaced Mario Gotze.
87' Dino Toppmoller has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) replacing Ansgar Knauff.
83' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
82' Ellyes Skhiri (Eintracht Frankfurt) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
81' Yan Couto (Dortmund) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Kevin Trapp, who smothers the ball.
80' Jamie Gittens (Dortmund) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
78' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) is cautioned by the referee after being shown a yellow card for dissent.
77' Emre Can (Dortmund) sees a yellow! His tackle wasn't that harsh, but he probably talked himself into Daniel Schlager's book.
77' PENALTY APPEAL by Dortmund, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
77' The total number of attempts is 11:9.
75' Oscar Hojlund (Eintracht Frankfurt) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Hugo Larsson.
75' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Tuta (Eintracht Frankfurt) is coming onto the pitch as Rasmus Kristensen cannot continue after picking up an injury.
74' Jamie Gittens (Dortmund) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
72' Nuri Sahin has decided to substitute Felix Nmecha and he is replaced by Maximilian Beier (Dortmund).
71' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Julian Brandt as he is replaced by Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund).
70' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Pascal Gross (Dortmund), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
69' Gregor Kobel comes off his line to intercept the corner from Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt).
68' The resulting set piece from Eintracht Frankfurt is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
66' Chance! Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) was in a good position inside the box, but he couldn't connect with the pass as it was overhit.
64' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Dortmund.
64' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) gets inside the box and only has the keeper to beat, but lashes his shot way over the bar.
63' One of the Eintracht Frankfurt players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
61' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it just over the bar.
60' Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends a chip pass into the box, but Gregor Kobel is quickest to intercept the ball.
59' Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
58' Jamie Gittens (Dortmund) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the left side of the target, but Kevin Trapp easily deals with the threat.
55' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) is able to continue to play.
52' The game is interrupted now, Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
50' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) gets a shot from distance but fails to generate enough power to beat the goalkeeper.
49' Yan Couto (Dortmund) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but Kevin Trapp pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
49' The Dortmund players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
46' Half-time substitution. Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) will not participate anymore and Yan Couto is coming on.
46' Referee Daniel Schlager blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Arthur Theate (Eintracht Frankfurt) unleashes a shot towards the goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies high over the bar.
45' The linesman points to the corner flag, Eintracht Frankfurt are going to take it.

43' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
42' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Dortmund for a penalty. Play continues.
37' Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt) bangs the ball towards goal from the edge of the box, but it's rising all the way and sails high over the bar.
36' A quickly taken corner by Dortmund.
36' Waldemar Anton (Dortmund) unleashed a powerful long-range strike, but the ball was blocked by a defender on its way. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Dortmund.
34' A sweet pass inside the box gives Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) time to measure a shot, but it's slightly mishit and goes just wide of the right post. That really was a great chance!
33' An attempted cross from Pascal Gross (Dortmund) is cleared.
32' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) tackles a bit over-zealously and Daniel Schlager blows for a foul.
31' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Dortmund.
30' Jamie Gittens (Dortmund) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
29' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Gregor Kobel.
28' Jamie Gittens (Dortmund) sends a cross into the box, but Kevin Trapp comes off his line to gather the ball.
26' Pascal Gross (Dortmund) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
23' A player from Eintracht Frankfurt commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
23' Eintracht Frankfurt will take a corner kick.
22' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) fires a brilliant shot from the edge of the box, but the effort rattles the right post! It could have been a superb goal.
21' Jamie Gittens (Dortmund) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
18' 1 - 0 Goal - 1:0! Rasmus Kristensen tees up Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) inside the box and he rolls the ball into the bottom left corner and past Gregor Kobel.
17' A player from Eintracht Frankfurt commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
16' Dortmund seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
12' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Dortmund will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
12' Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.

9' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball glanced away off the left post!
8' Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
7' Dortmund will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
4' Corner kick. Eintracht Frankfurt will have an opportunity.
4' Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears. The referee points to the corner flag and Eintracht Frankfurt will take a corner.
2' Hugo Larsson (Eintracht Frankfurt) has a sight of goal and shoots towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper makes a superb save.
1' Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt) has a crack at goal from the edge of the box, but it drifts high over the bar to safety.

Eintracht Frankfurt will kick-off.
